    intro x hx
    have he : separation 0 x≤b := (doors (o:=0) x).mp (H.contained (h:=h) (hk:=hk) (hN:=hN) v (Sum.inr a) hx)
    rw [separation_comm]; exact (Nat.mul_le_mul_left 10 he).trans_lt H.cap

proof_context.conclusion: A support lying in `patch b 0` has `Nonwrapping (L.support a.val) 0`, since `separation 0 x <= b` and `Provision.cap : 10*R < side`, so the projection estimate applies.

structure Provision (C : Family G) (d k N p i R : ℕ) : Prop where
  footprint : (C.localSection d).stencil ⊆ box R
  cap : 10*R<(C.side k p).val
  cuts : i*(4*(C.path.rep N p k).p.B+2)+2*(C.path.rep N p k).p.B ≤ R
  length : 2*(R+1)<(C.side k p).val

proof_context.conclusion: `Provision` supplies the footprint in `box R` and the period inequalities `cap`, `length` for the actual side `C.side k p`.

theorem shared_price (e : κ ↪ ι) (f : κ ↪ ι') (i j : κ)
    (D : Cost X) (D' : Cost Y) (a : ι → X) (b : ι' → Y)
    {R M V W σ γ μ u r : ℝ} {A : Matrix ι ι ℝ} {B : Matrix ι' ι' ℝ}
    (ha : ∀ k : ι, k ∉ Set.range e → R ≤ D.d (a (e i)) (a k))
    (hb : ∀ k : ι', k ∉ Set.range f → R ≤ D'.d (b (f i)) (b k))
    (he : D.pull (a ∘ e) = D'.pull (b ∘ f))
    (hp : D.Schur a a σ M A) (hq : D'.Schur b b σ M B)
    (hg : Gap A r) (hg' : Gap B r)
    (hx : D.Volume a (safeRate σ M r-μ) V)
    (hy : D'.Volume b (safeRate σ M r-μ) V)
    (hz : D.Schur (a ∘ e) (a ∘ e) γ W (A.submatrix e e-B.submatrix f f))
    (hu : 0 ≤ u) (hr : 0 < r) (hs : 0 < σ) (hM : 0 ≤ M) (hγ : 0 ≤ γ) (hm : γ ≤ μ)
    (hσ : μ ≤ σ) (hV : 0 ≤ V) (hW : 0 ≤ W) :
    D.weight γ (a (e i)) (a (e j)) * |resolve A u (e j) (e i)-resolve B u (f j) (f i)| ≤
      windowPrice M V r u μ γ R + (V*(r/2+u)⁻¹)*W*(V*(r/2+u)⁻¹) + windowPrice M V r u μ γ R := by

proof_context.conclusion: Two periods with different index sets are compared on a common matched patch with a price that does not depend on the period.
